subtitles.en: This reporting is based on the OEMs, the server makers going to customers and saying this is what we see happening in the new year.

subtitles.zh: 在某些情况下，Blackwell和Ruben系统的价格上涨了15%，您对此有何反应？
subtitles.en: 15% hike in some cases on Blackwell and Ruben systems, just to start your reaction to that.

subtitles.zh: 我对此并不感到意外。很明显，内存成本一直在上升。

subtitles.zh: 我们观察到并听说大型超大规模运营商预测资本支出预算将增加，而最大的驱动因素就是内存成本。
subtitles.en: We have observed and heard the large hyperscale operators forecasting higher capital spending budgets and the biggest driver for that has been the cost of memory.

subtitles.zh: 所以，这确实不应该让人感到意外。
subtitles.en: So there really should be very little surprise.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，考虑到内存成本的百分比增长以及这些AI平台所需的内存量，15%的涨幅在支出规模面前并不显得过高。
subtitles.en: As a matter of fact, given the percentage increase in the cost of memory and the amount of memory required in these AI platforms, 15% really doesn't seem all that demanding when we consider the amount of spending.

subtitles.zh: 每个Blackwell和Ruben GPU都有八个对应的HBM堆栈，每个堆栈由12层DRAM组成。
subtitles.en: Each Blackwell and Ruben GPU has eight corresponding HBM stacks, which in turn are 12 layers of DRAM.

subtitles.zh: 西蒙，考虑到这一点，您认为15%的涨幅还会继续上升吗？
subtitles.en: 15% could you see that going higher Simon with that in mind?

subtitles.zh: 我认为有可能，但挑战在于我们不知道Nvidia在之前的定价中包含了什么，所以目前有很多未知因素。
subtitles.en: Well, I think it's possible that the challenges is we don't know what Nvidia built into the prior pricing, so there's a lot we don't know at this point.

subtitles.zh: 回想一下，黄仁勋曾多次表示，他们两年前就预测到了所需的内存量。
subtitles.en: Recall that that Jensen Wang has said repeatedly that they predicted that the amount of memory they need two years ago.

subtitles.zh: 所以他们一直在努力锁定供应。
